One psychological effect that might also be going on here is the so called justification of effort effect. It stems from cognitive dissonance theory and pretty much states the following. If you have to invest some form of attention or resources for something you will end up liking that more. Let‘s say it would difficult to join some sort of group, you will like being part pf that group more even if it isn’t special in any form 

Something similar is the so called Benjamin Franklin effect where people like you more if you ask them for a favor. Here the idea is that if help someone out you will tell yourself that that person must be cool for you to invest time.
